order: 학습 단위 비교 (발주문 v2), 2026-11-17, 실험 조건 세션 → 사용자 전달
payload_v1_read_only: JointBuildGS-artifacts/phase-payloads/phd/main_trainunit_v1/PHD-MAIN-TRAINUNIT-v1 (mounted read-only at /tu1; campus scene, campus targets, finished runs and their scores are read from there)
crs: EPSG:25832; training frame = EPSG:25832 minus (690953, 5336071) in x, y (WIDEN0-v2 rule)

method.name: 본 방법 r23 (src/phd/forks/GeoGS-conf-guided-v1-r23) + CityGaussianV2 elongation filter 0.01 (TRAINUNIT-v1 addendum 12, tu_train_entry.install_elongation_filter)
method.same_as: cellsef_ALS_s0 (cells) and <site>ef_ALS_s0/s1 (building unit): tu_host.train_args, tu_host.command, tu_train_entry.main unchanged
method.unchanged: judgment, target rule r8, losses, learning rates, densification rule, mesh rule, tau, scorer
method.changed: only the region (cells) and the image list; for 3.3 only the prior (scene_LoD2, /ft/stage1/<site>__LoD2)

cellsef_ALS_s0.status: trained, merged and scored in v1
cellsef_ALS_s0.action: read v1 scores (family cellsef_ALS_s0); no rerun

cells9ef_ALS_s0.action: train 9 cells one after another on GPU 1 (runs cells9ef_ALS_s0_cell<k>, k = 0..8), 30,000 each; merge; score; family cells9ef_ALS_s0
cells9ef_ALS_s0.entry: as cellsef_ALS_s0_cell<k>: elongation filter 0.01, FINALTRAIN count rule recorded only (addendum 4), scene radius of the fork (not fixed), read-only family monitor with watch {}
cells9ef_ALS_s0.order: cells with most training images first

<site>ef_ALS_s0/s1.status: trained and scored in v1 (families ef_s0, ef_s1)

<site>ef_LoD2_s0/s1.action: train 6 runs (B0ef_LoD2_s0, B0ef_LoD2_s1, R1repef_LoD2_s0, R1repef_LoD2_s1, B173nbef_LoD2_s0, B173nbef_LoD2_s1)
<site>ef_LoD2_s0/s1.entry: as <site>ef_ALS_s<seed>: elongation filter 0.01, FINALTRAIN count rule enforced as in those runs, family monitor with watch {} (the ALS watch ids are ALS seed ids; the monitor is read-only)

runs.not_run: LoD2 for 전체, 넷, 아홉 (commands written only, section 4); comparison methods; finished runs; stopped v1 runs (cellsef_ALS_s0_cell1fix, pre-filter cells_ALS_s0, campus30k_ALS_s0)

cells9.method: VastGaussian (Lin et al. 2024) progressive partition, as trainunit_v1.json cells, only the count changed
cells9.count: m x n = 3 x 3 (order v2 section 0.3)
cells9.partition: training camera centres (WIDEN0-v2 819 training images, x-y) split along x into 3 columns with equal counts, then each column along y into 3 rows with equal counts; cuts = np.quantile(values, [1/3, 2/3]) (numpy linear interpolation; for 2 parts this is the v1 np.median rule); a cell is [lower cut, upper cut); outer boundaries extend to infinity
cells9.expand: 20 %, as v1 (each finite edge outward by 20 % of the extent of the cell's own camera centres along that axis)
cells9.camera_selection: as v1: centre inside the expanded cell, or projected expanded box (8 corners, z = 0.5-99.5th percentile SfM z inside the expanded cell) covers >= 25 % of the image
cells9.points_targets_maps_seeds: as v1 (tu_campus.seeds/maps/index with unit cell<k> in the v2 payload; campus targets campus__ALS.npz of v1 read-only)
cells9.merge: as v1: keep Gaussians with xy in the original cell [min, max); concatenate nine 30,000 point_cloud.ply
cells9.records_per_cell: own cameras, training images (position + visibility), test images, SfM points in the expanded cell, prior patches (active), expanded cell width and height (finite part clipped at SfM 0.5/99.5 % xy), scene radius (fork getNerfppNorm: 1.1 x max distance of training camera centres from their mean) and the thresholds derived from it: clone/split scale threshold percent_dense 0.01 x radius, big-Gaussian prune 0.1 x radius, position lr scale = radius
cells9.same_records_for: 1 unit (campus) and 2 x 2 (v1 cells.json, copied from v1 records)

building_membership.rule: each building of WIDEN0-v2 inputs/lod2_buildings.json (154) belongs to the one cell whose original (unexpanded) boundary [min, max) contains the area centroid of its GroundSurface polygons (exterior rings, area-weighted, holes ignored) in the training frame
building_membership.record: cell per building; buildings whose GroundSurface vertices are not all inside the expanded cell of their cell (count and ids); not corrected
building_membership.for: 2 x 2 and 3 x 3 (1 unit: all in the one unit)

evaluation_boxes: GTJUDGE views/<site>.json box (B0_b10, R1rep_b10, B173nb_b10): cells touched (original boundary), boundary crosses box, nearest original boundary distance, within 2 m
mesh: GTJUDGE mesh_job.py unchanged (render -> prepare -> plan -> tile -> merge -> finish) on the run cropped to the evaluation box (tu_postcpu.crop); render image list = the building-unit scene split /p/fork_inputs/s61/<site>/split.json; RESCORE merge with 1e-12 m copy tolerance (tu_merge_tol.py) only where the unchanged merge stops on roundoff, recorded

scoring.scorer: GTJUDGE score_new.py + add2_scores.metric_rows (accuracy rule of GTJUDGE addendum 2 section 3.4) as trainunit_v1.json scoring
scoring.four_cases: case_id 0 둘 다 맞음, 1 영상만 맞음, 2 사전 정보만 맞음, 4 영상 없음; scene = 'all'
scoring.boundary_band: reference rows within 2 m (xy) of an original cell boundary of the plan (넷: v1 cells.json boundaries, 아홉: v2 cells.json boundaries): completeness, floating share (s > tau), no-surface share; '없음' if no row lies in the band
scoring.gt_use: reference only in scoring and figures

stop_trace.new_runs_recorder: read-only hook every 1,000 iterations (and iteration 1): gaussian count, share of rows with min(scale)/max(scale) < 0.01 and < 0.1, host RSS of the training process (VmRSS) and peak (VmHWM), container cgroup memory.current, CUDA allocated/reserved current and peak; no random numbers, no model write (trace1000.jsonl)
stop_trace.old_runs: jbgs_trace.jsonl (every 100: gaussians, peak CUDA, peak RSS), family_monitor.jsonl (densification steps: before/after counts, needle (<= 0.01) count), saved point_cloud.ply / jbgs_complete checkpoints for elongation distributions, receipts, train.log, command.json
stop_trace.rule: class only with evidence rows; otherwise 알 수 없음 with what would decide it

gpu.start_rule: nvidia-smi -i 1 shows no compute process other than display (gnome/Xorg) and host MemAvailable >= 45 GB (campus-size scoring: >= 45 GB)
gpu.host_guard: host MemAvailable < 20 GB -> this task's container is killed (as v1); snapshot of memory users is recorded
gpu.gaussian_guard: as the copied runs (renderer binning guard fraction of FINALTRAIN; count rule as in the copied run)
gpu.retry: order v2 1.8: execution error or memory stop -> cause first (3.5); config/code fault -> fix (not 0.2 values) and rerun; otherwise one rerun with the same config, then '결과 없음' and next
gpu.launch: nohup host queue; checks at intervals >= 10 min

outputs.qualitative: order v2 5.2 (one container per site x plan for figures; memory limit 32 GiB, else '없음' with reason)
outputs.bundles: PHD-MAIN-TRAINUNIT-v2_준비_<MMDD-HHMM>.zip after step 1; _가_ after 아홉 + 전체 scoring; final after LoD2

lod2_prepared_only: commands for 전체, 넷, 아홉 LoD2 written under PHD-MAIN-TRAINUNIT-v2/prepared/, not launched
